blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — A high-value drug suspect was arrested in a buy-bust operation in Marawi City on Saturday, Nov. 14, yielding approximately one kilogram of suspected shabu worth P6.8 million, according to the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency–Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PDEA-BAR). George Paul Alcovindas, PDEA-BAR regional director, identified the suspect as alias “Ali,” 42, married, and a resident of Barangay Proper, Maguing, Lanao del Sur. Alcovindas said the seized drugs were concealed inside a green Chinese tea bag labeled “Guanyinwang (AOE).” The suspected shabu (methamphetamine hydrochloride) weighed approximately 1,006 grams and was valued at P6,840,000.
